content.name: Tyler Brooks
content.title: Assistant Operations Manager
content.summary: Supply chain graduate from Georgia State University, promoted from shift supervisor to assistant operations manager at a regional food distributor within 21 months. Runs night-shift picking and loading for 140 delivery routes and raised order accuracy from 97.1% to 99.3%.

experience.title: Assistant Operations Manager
bullets: Run night-shift receiving, picking and loading for 140 daily delivery routes with a crew of 46 associates.
Introduced pick-to-label audits and a short pre-shift huddle, raising order accuracy from 97.1% to 99.3%.
Rebuilt the loading sequence with dispatch so trucks leave on time 94% of nights, up from 81%.
Track labor hours against volume each week and cut overtime by 18% without missing a delivery window.

experience.title: Operations Shift Supervisor
bullets: Supervised 22 order selectors in a refrigerated warehouse handling about 30,000 cases a night.
Trained 35 new hires on voice picking and forklift safety; first-90-day turnover fell from 42% to 27%.
Led the shift through an OSHA recordable-free year in 2024.

education.degree: B.B.A. in Managerial Sciences, Supply Chain Management concentration
education.school: Georgia State University, J. Mack Robinson College of Business
education.details: GPA 3.5/4.0; capstone on cross-dock layout for a local nonprofit food bank
